sections.title: Welfare Benefits Program and health coverage
Money matters, data privacy, channels and conduct

questions.text: In a cooperative, a member is at the same time an owner, a user and what else?
How many cooperative principles does the International Cooperative Alliance set out?
Which cooperative principle does the PMES itself put into practice?
Which body regulates cooperatives in the Philippines?
How are votes counted in a cooperative?
Which of these is one of the six cooperative values?
Where did the 28 weavers open the store that gave the world its first cooperative principles in 1844?
Who founded the rural credit cooperatives in Germany that credit unions descend from?
Which law created the Cooperative Development Authority?
RA 9520, the Philippine Cooperative Code of 2008, was signed into law in which year?
Which section of the 1987 Constitution directs the State to create an agency to promote cooperatives?
Our 1976 registration was made under which law?
In what year was the cooperative founded?
Under what name was the cooperative first organized?
options: ISAT Alumni, Teachers and Employees Cooperative Credit Union, Inc.
ISAT U and Community Multi-Purpose Cooperative

questions.text: How many founding cooperators signed the Articles in 1963?
In 1995 the cooperative changed from a credit union to what kind of cooperative?
What is the cooperative's CDA registration number?
According to the mission, the cooperative serves members' needs through entrepreneurial endeavors and what else?
options: Financial assistance based on self-help and resource pooling

questions.text: Which of these is an ownership stake rather than a deposit you can withdraw?
The maximum Multi-Purpose Loan is based on what?
options: Three times the member's capital share

questions.text: Which loan product has the longest term, up to 84 months?
Who assesses a loan application and who approves it?
options: The cashier assesses; the Secretary approves
The Loans Department assesses; the General Manager or the Board approves
The Audit Committee assesses; the Chairperson approves
The member assesses; the Treasurer approves

questions.text: Your purchases at the cooperative's store, laundry and copy center count toward what?
options: Your patronage, on which the patronage refund is computed

questions.text: What penalty rate applies to a loan in default?
How much is the monthly contribution to the Enhanced Welfare Program?
How many months of continuous contribution are required before the hospitalization benefit can be claimed?
What is the hospitalization benefit per day of confinement, and for how many days a year at most?
Which document is required to claim the hospitalization benefit?
Who approves the hospitalization loan from the welfare fund, and how fast is it released?
How is the Maxicare HMO premium paid under the cooperative's arrangement?
options: The member pays Maxicare directly every month
The cooperative pays the premium in full and the member repays it in 12 monthly installments through a hospitalization loan
The welfare fund pays it as a benefit
The University pays it for employees

questions.text: Who may become a regular member?
options: Regular employees of ISAT U and its satellite campuses, and regular employees of the cooperative

questions.text: Which right does an associate member NOT have?
options: To vote at the General Assembly
To earn interest on share capital

questions.text: What is the one-time membership fee?
How many shares must an applicant subscribe, and how many must be paid on approval?
How much written notice must a member give the Board to withdraw voluntarily?
A member is liable for the debts of the cooperative up to what amount?
Under continuous capital build-up, what minimum share of monthly income goes to share capital?
What happens to a member's voting rights if they become delinquent in share capital or other obligations?
options: Voting rights are suspended until the Board lifts the suspension

questions.text: What is the highest policy-making body of the cooperative?
How many directors sit on the Board, and for how long?
What is the quorum of a General Assembly meeting?
Which two committees are elected directly by the General Assembly?
Who presides over the Education and Training Committee as ex officio chair?
Which two officers are appointed from outside the Board of Directors?
Within how many days after the close of the fiscal year must the annual General Assembly be held?
Which document is the cooperative's charter: who we are, what we do, where we operate and how much capital?
What vote is needed to amend the Articles of Cooperation or the By-Laws?
options: Two-thirds of all members with voting rights

questions.text: What share of the net surplus is set aside for the Reserve Fund?
After the statutory funds, what share of the net surplus goes back to members as interest on share capital and patronage refund?
What is the first step in settling a dispute inside the cooperative?
options: Mediation and conciliation by the committee
A vote of the General Assembly

questions.text: What is the authorized share capital in the Articles of Cooperation, and the par value per share?
What is RA 9520?
Which agency does RA 9520 empower to register and regulate cooperatives?
Which article of RA 9520 sets the order of distribution of the net surplus?
Under RA 9520, transactions of a cooperative with its members are what?
Is proxy voting allowed at the General Assembly?
options: No, there is no proxy voting

questions.text: Within how many days after year end must the Cooperative Annual Progress Report (CAPR) be filed with the CDA?
Which charge is NOT deducted when a loan is released?
What should a member do before falling behind on loan payments?
options: Talk to the Loans Department about restructuring

questions.text: Which law governs how the cooperative protects your personal data?
options: RA 10173, the Data Privacy Act of 2012

questions.text: What is the address of the member portal (MemberFolio)?
Within how many days of filing must the Board act on a membership application?
Directors and officers may not do which of the following?
options: Hold an operating position in the cooperative or run a competing business
